opportunities.exact_claim: For every finite d, EB CPTP Psi and unital TP HS-self-adjoint Phi, an all-Hermitian Dirichlet comparison with finite C forces Psi unital and admits one canonical EB Gamma with the same C.
opportunities.mechanism: Identity cross terms force unitality; averaging measurement and preparation POVMs gives simultaneous sum-of-squares quadratic domination.
supplied_inputs: finite EB representation if an explicit POVM is required
opportunities.costs: At most twice the supplied EB outcome count before pure refinement; no acquisition of an EB decomposition is provided.
opportunities.historical_importance: Corrects the canonical-versus-arbitrary EB distinction for the precise full-domain comparator interface; it is an elementary scoped result, not a claimed foundational breakthrough.
opportunities.strongest_primary_relation: Toth-Pitrik Observation 1 on fixed-marginal symmetric separable correlations
opportunities.missing_lemma_for_ambitious_endpoint: An arbitrary-rank common canonical comparator with dimension-independent C for all selfcompatible bistochastic reversible channels.
compatibility_obligations: All Hermitian matrices, including identity cross terms
opportunities.early_falsification_test: Replacement EB channels show that a merely traceless contract cannot be used to infer unitality.

opportunities.exact_claim: For every finite-dimensional anticommuting traceless Hermitian involution family and every supplied selfcompatible unital TP HS-self-adjoint CPTP Phi, one canonical EB Psi satisfies I-Psi <= 2(I-Phi) as quadratic forms simultaneously on the entire real Clifford span, and also on its affine identity extension.
opportunities.mechanism: Commuting receiver-pair sign sectors reduce the three-register star to degree-p/degree-(k+1-p) blocks. A representation-independent Schur bound and weighted layer-cake imply Tr[(2M-I)_+]<=1, yielding one explicit mixed spectral POVM.
opportunities.costs: k^2 supplied-channel HS correlations, a real k-by-k eigendecomposition, at most 2k+1 dense POVM effects; physical measurement and channel acquisition remain separately charged.
opportunities.historical_importance: Removes the tree's logarithmic frame-rank loss on a structured observable subspace and excludes growing Clifford frames as universal-constant counterexamples. The arbitrary-frame target remains open.
strongest_primary_relations: Botteron et al. broader unconstrained-receiver encryption star game
opportunities.missing_lemma_for_ambitious_endpoint: A common canonical support/rounding bound for positive dual frames lacking exact Clifford relations.
compatibility_obligations: One shared broadcaster with both marginals Phi
Affinely centered state families must lie in the Clifford span
opportunities.early_falsification_test: Star-norm diagnostics k=1 through 7, including even ranks and the odd self-layer; fourteen finite checks passed. Finite tests do not establish the theorem.

rejected_transfer: Neither arbitrary dual frames nor unrestricted receiver observables in unclonable-encryption games satisfy the exact Clifford sign-sector relations. No universal theorem follows from this restricted proof.
